result.root_cause: Untrusted zip entry names are resolved against the destination directory without verifying the result stays inside it, letting ../ sequences escape the target directory during extraction.
result.summary: Our patch adds a canonical-path containment check at the exact extraction sink (extractFile, right after FileUtils.resolveFile), rejecting any entry whose real path is not the dest dir or under dest+separator. This is the CWE-022 defense-of-record and is strictly stronger than the official fix, which uses non-canonical getAbsolutePath and lacks a separator boundary (vulnerable to unresolved ../, symlinks, and sibling-prefix names like /dest-evil). POV no longer reproduces, regressions pass, and benign nested extraction is preserved.
